text: Understanding every child's world, one sense at a time

Every child experiences the world differently — how they move, focus, regulate, and respond to sound, touch and space all shape how they learn and play. sections.label: Assessment and therapy, tailored to your child
text: Assessment and therapy, tailored to your child
From first assessment through to ongoing therapy, every step is built around your child's needs and your family's daily life.
OT Assessments
Comprehensive assessment of sensory processing, fine and gross motor skills, and everyday functional abilities, with a clear written report.
1:1 Therapy Programmes
Individualised, goal-led therapy sessions delivered in clinic, at home, or in school, with regular review of progress.
School-Based Support
Classroom observations, environment adaptations, and staff training to help schools support pupils day to day.
Parent & Carer Coaching
Practical, everyday strategies for home — mealtimes, dressing, transitions and self-regulation — coached alongside you.
What we offer

sections.label: Frequently asked questions
text: Frequently asked questions
Do I need a GP or specialist referral?
No — for private assessments and therapy, parents and carers can refer directly. Schools and other professionals can also refer with parental consent.
Can your reports be used for an EHCP application or annual review?
Yes. Our assessment reports are written in a format suitable for supporting Education, Health and Care Plan applications, reviews and tribunal evidence.
Where do sessions take place?
We offer sessions in our clinic, at your child's school, at home, or online for review and coaching sessions where appropriate.
What areas of the UK do you cover?
We work with families and schools across England, with in-person visits available in most regions and remote consultations offered UK-wide.
How long does an assessment take?
A typical initial assessment takes 60–90 minutes, with additional time for standardised testing where needed. You'll receive a written report within two to three weeks.
